scenarios.user_prompt: Turn this single-view cartoon character into an interactive 3D avatar page with orbit, gestures, and optional voice-reactive mouth movement.
expected: Generate one Sunburst turnaround sheet and treat hidden-angle details as estimates.
Build the character from volumetric Three.js geometry rather than a plane or billboard.
Deliver a no-build HTML page and verify that its canvas and controls render in a browser.

scenarios.user_prompt: Use these front, profile, and back character references to make an orbitable avatar.
expected: Use the supplied views directly and skip an unnecessary paid image edit.
Keep face details attached to the curved model through front, three-quarter, and profile views.

scenarios.user_prompt: Verify the avatar page. I have not approved microphone access for this test.
expected: Do not accept a browser microphone permission prompt.
Verify the off state and inspect that audio is analyzed locally without recording, playback, or upload.

scenarios.user_prompt: Start the microphone, hide the page while permission is pending, then resolve permission.
expected: Invalidate the pending microphone request when the page is hidden or unloaded.
Stop every track from a stream that resolves after cancellation and leave the UI in the off state.

scenarios.user_prompt: Build the sample moth avatar and inspect its cheek markings from the front and three-quarter views.
expected: Cheek spots remain visibly attached to the curved head from both views.
Spots rotate with the head instead of floating independently or sinking behind the surface.
